title: Learning a Language for Work
paragraphs: When his company began expanding into new markets, Danial realized his job would soon require regularly communicating with clients in a language he had never formally studied before.
He enrolled in evening classes twice a week, finding it humbling to sit alongside much younger students who seemed to grasp new vocabulary far more quickly than he did.
During one difficult client call, he stumbled over several words but managed to communicate the essential message, and the client patiently helped him find the right phrase when needed.

A year into consistent study, Danial handled an entire client meeting in the new language without needing a translator, realizing that his early embarrassment had been worth the eventual confidence gained.
